scene.motionPrompt: A young man in near darkness, head lowered toward the phone held in both hands. He blinks once. His chest rises and falls with one quiet breath. His right thumb shifts a few millimetres and settles. The camera pushes in very slowly, about three percent across the shot, holding the same framing and eyeline. Soft red rim light drifts almost imperceptibly along the left of his hair and jaw. Shallow natural depth and gentle parallax, low key black and deep red lighting, photorealistic and restrained, premium sports commercial. The phone is seen from behind, its rear surface dark and matte, held rigid and flat. Do not alter his facial identity, features, skin, hair or clothing, and do not add or change any person. Do not add lettering, numbers, a mark, a badge or any product interface anywhere in frame. Do not bend, warp, reshape, resize or reorient the phone; its silhouette and dark rear surface stay rigid, and the whole phone stays inside frame. Do not duplicate or deform fingers or hands. Do not turn the head sharply, smile or speak. Do not add camera shake, particles, sparks, flares, neon or cyberpunk effects. Do not generate audio.
